Townsfolk.name: Grandmother
Townsfolk.description: You start knowing a good player & their character. If the Demon kills them, you die too.
Townsfolk.firstNightReminder: Show the marked character token. Point to the marked player.
Townsfolk.otherNightReminder: If the Grandmother's grandchild was killed by the Demon tonight: The Grandmother dies.

Townsfolk.name: Sailor
Townsfolk.description: Each night, choose an alive player: either you or they are drunk until dusk. You can't die.
Townsfolk.firstNightReminder: The Sailor points to a living player. Either the Sailor, or the chosen player, is drunk.
Townsfolk.otherNightReminder: The previously drunk player is no longer drunk. The Sailor points to a living player. Either the Sailor, or the chosen player, is drunk.

Townsfolk.name: Chambermaid
Townsfolk.description: Each night, choose 2 alive players (not yourself): you learn how many woke tonight due to their ability.
Townsfolk.firstNightReminder: The Chambermaid points to two players. Show the number signal (0, 1, 2, …) for how many of those players wake tonight for their ability.
Townsfolk.otherNightReminder: The Chambermaid points to two players. Show the number signal (0, 1, 2, …) for how many of those players wake tonight for their ability.

Townsfolk.name: Exorcist
Townsfolk.description: Each night*, choose a player (different to last night): the Demon, if chosen, learns who you are then doesn't wake tonight.
Townsfolk.otherNightReminder: The Exorcist points to a player, different from the previous night. If that player is the Demon: Wake the Demon. Show the Exorcist token. Point to the Exorcist. The Demon does not act tonight.

Townsfolk.name: Innkeeper
Townsfolk.description: Each night*, choose 2 players: they can't die tonight, but 1 is drunk until dusk.
Townsfolk.otherNightReminder: The previously protected and drunk players lose those markers. The Innkeeper points to two players. Those players are protected. One is drunk.

Townsfolk.name: Gambler
Townsfolk.description: Each night*, choose a player & guess their character: if you guess wrong, you die.
Townsfolk.otherNightReminder: The Gambler points to a player, and a character on their sheet. If incorrect, the Gambler dies.

Townsfolk.name: Gossip
Townsfolk.description: Each day, you may make a public statement. Tonight, if it was true, a player dies.
Townsfolk.otherNightReminder: If the Gossip's public statement was true: Choose a player not protected from dying tonight. That player dies.

Townsfolk.name: Courtier
Townsfolk.description: Once per game, at night, choose a character: they are drunk for 3 nights & 3 days.
Townsfolk.firstNightReminder: The Courtier either shows a 'no' head signal, or points to a character on the sheet. If the Courtier used their ability: If that character is in play, that player is drunk.
Townsfolk.otherNightReminder: Reduce the remaining number of days the marked player is poisoned. If the Courtier has not yet used their ability: The Courtier either shows a 'no' head signal, or points to a character on the sheet. If the Courtier used their ability: If that character is in play, that player is drunk.

Townsfolk.name: Professor
Townsfolk.description: Once per game, at night*, choose a dead player: if they are a Townsfolk, they are resurrected.
Townsfolk.otherNightReminder: If the Professor has not used their ability: The Professor either shakes their head no, or points to a player. If that player is a Townsfolk, they are now alive.

Townsfolk.name: Minstrel
Townsfolk.description: When a Minion dies by execution, all other players (except Travellers) are drunk until dusk tomorrow.

Townsfolk.name: Tea Lady
Townsfolk.description: If both your alive neighbours are good, they can't die.

Townsfolk.name: Pacifist
Townsfolk.description: Executed good players might not die.

Townsfolk.name: Fool
Townsfolk.description: The first time you die, you don't.

Outsiders.name: Tinker
Outsiders.description: You might die at any time.

Outsiders.name: Moonchild
Outsiders.description: When you learn that you died, publicly choose 1 alive player. Tonight, if it was a good player, they die.
Outsiders.otherNightReminder: If the Moonchild used their ability to target a player today: If that player is good, they die.

Outsiders.name: Goon
Outsiders.description: Each night, the 1st player to choose you with their ability is drunk until dusk. You become their alignment.

Outsiders.name: Lunatic
Outsiders.description: You think you are a Demon, but you are not. The Demon knows who you are & who you choose at night.
Outsiders.firstNightReminder: If 7 or more players: Show the Lunatic a number of arbitrary 'Minions', players equal to the number of Minions in play. Show 3 character tokens of arbitrary good characters. If the token received by the Lunatic is a Demon that would wake tonight: Allow the Lunatic to do the Demon actions. Place their 'attack' markers. Wake the Demon. Show the Demon's real character token. Show them the Lunatic player. If the Lunatic attacked players: Show the real demon each marked player. Remove any Lunatic 'attack' markers.
Outsiders.otherNightReminder: Allow the Lunatic to do the actions of the Demon. Place their 'attack' markers. If the Lunatic selected players: Wake the Demon. Show the 'attack' marker, then point to each marked player. Remove any Lunatic 'attack' markers.

Minions.name: Godfather
Minions.description: You start knowing which Outsiders are in play. If 1 died today, choose a player tonight: they die. [-1 or +1 Outsider]
Minions.firstNightReminder: Show each of the Outsider tokens in play.
Minions.otherNightReminder: If an Outsider died today: The Godfather points to a player. That player dies.

Minions.name: Devil's Advocate
Minions.description: Each night, choose a living player (different to last night): if executed tomorrow, they don't die.
Minions.firstNightReminder: The Devil's Advocate points to a living player. That player survives execution tomorrow.
Minions.otherNightReminder: The Devil's Advocate points to a living player, different from the previous night. That player survives execution tomorrow.

Minions.name: Assassin
Minions.description: Once per game, at night*, choose a player: they die, even if for some reason they could not.
Minions.otherNightReminder: If the Assassin has not yet used their ability: The Assassin either shows the 'no' head signal, or points to a player. That player dies.

Minions.name: Mastermind
Minions.description: If the Demon dies by execution (ending the game), play for 1 more day. If a player is then executed, their team loses.

Demons.name: Zombuul
Demons.description: Each night*, if no-one died today, choose a player: they die. The 1st time you die, you live but register as dead.
Demons.otherNightReminder: If no-one died during the day: The Zombuul points to a player. That player dies.

Demons.name: Pukka
Demons.description: Each night, choose a player: they are poisoned. The previously poisoned player dies then becomes healthy.
Demons.firstNightReminder: The Pukka points to a player. That player is poisoned.
Demons.otherNightReminder: The Pukka points to a player. That player is poisoned. The previously poisoned player dies.

Demons.name: Shabaloth
Demons.description: Each night*, choose 2 players: they die. A dead player you chose last night might be regurgitated.
Demons.otherNightReminder: One player that the Shabaloth chose the previous night might be resurrected. The Shabaloth points to two players. Those players die.

Demons.name: Po
Demons.description: Each night*, you may choose a player: they die. If your last choice was no-one, choose 3 players tonight.
Demons.otherNightReminder: If the Po chose no-one the previous night: The Po points to three players. Otherwise: The Po either shows the 'no' head signal , or points to a player. Chosen players die

Travellers.name: Apprentice
Travellers.description: On your 1st night, you gain a Townsfolk ability (if good), or a Minion ability (if evil).
Travellers.firstNightReminder: Show the Apprentice the 'You are' card, then a Townsfolk or Minion token. In the Grimoire, replace the Apprentice token with that character token, and put the Apprentice's 'Is the Apprentice' reminder by that character token.

Travellers.name: Matron
Travellers.description: Each day, you may choose up to 3 sets of 2 players to swap seats. Players may not leave their seats to talk in private.

Travellers.name: Judge
Travellers.description: Once per game, if another player nominated, you may choose to force the current execution to pass or fail.

Travellers.name: Bishop
Travellers.description: Only the Storyteller can nominate. At least 1 opposite player must be nominated each day.

Travellers.name: Voudon
Travellers.description: Only you and the dead can vote. They don't need a vote token to do so. A 50% majority is not required.
